name: design-rigor
cut: F18 SBBF + path-sorted layout + read-only os.walk + .icloud skip

name: measurability
cut: per-query us + blob_size + speedup + path/app count + placeholder count

name: enforcement-strength
cut: self-fixture synth + magic check + version pin + lstat-only invariant

name: atomicity
cut: single .hexa + 0 side effects + /tmp blob + NO fdownload trigger

name: observability
cut: rss/elapsed/blob_size + source kind + classifier_version + per-app dict

name: emission-cost-bounded
cut: payload <=16KB + 1-pass walk + /tmp cache + lstat-only no open

name: adversarial-resistance
cut: empty + sparse-host + placeholder-only + TCC-denied + synth fallback

desc: iCloud sync state mutable mid-walk; blob is snapshot not live view
mtime_days reflects local replica lstat mtime, not iCloud server time
TCC-denied subtree silently skipped; logged in source kind only
.icloud placeholder skip is basename heuristic; Apple may rotate
synth fallback skips real per-app dict skew exercise
sparse-host probe (3 files); per-app B5 dense-only verified
